description.en: Motion-heavy React components ready to copy and paste for silky user interfaces.
description.zh: 重度动画与丝滑交互兼具的 React 动效组件库，即粘即用零摩擦。

content.en: Smooth UI is an open-source, animation-centric collection of React components developed by Eduard Constantin. Leveraging Framer Motion and Tailwind CSS, each component is fine-tuned to eliminate abrupt transitions, ensuring that layout changes feel organic and tactile.
content.zh: Smooth UI 是由 Eduard Constantin 主理的以极致平滑动效为核心卖点的开源 React 组件库。深度运用 Framer Motion 与 Tailwind CSS，消除了任何生硬突兀的视觉跳变，使得弹出层展开、卡片悬浮与页面切换如水流般自然顺畅。
